description: Take sales-advantage from code-complete to a deployed MVP. The feature surface (domain, tRPC router, audio-upload route, rep/admin UI, chat, quiz, curriculum seed script) already exists on HEAD per the 2026-06-26 line review; sales_advantage_mvp_20260622 Phases 3-7 are implemented (its checkboxes are stale). This track owns the remaining Phase-8 go-live work: hard-gate on Wave 1 sales security remediation, seed + human-approve real curriculum, add Docker/cloudbuild, provision the cloud sales_advantage database, deploy to Cloud Run, and run end-to-end QA.
